newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's o/n rates steady, seen dropping.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's o/n rates steady, seen dropping.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates finished at Wednesday's closing level, but the market traded at slightly lower rates as banks felt safer about their reserves, dealers said on Thursday.
The overnight rates closed at 22.875, compared with Wednesday's end of 22.75/22.875.
Dealers said banks filled their reserves early this week and they are likely to lay out excess funds on the overnight and the tom/next market perhaps from this afternoon.

"There was a little drop, and a larger drop can be expected," said Istvan Hideg of Takarekbank. "Market talks have made me feel that the banks has much money. The question is when this money enters the market."
He added tom/next rates may drop this afternoon to between 22.75 and 22.625.
